thread:
anna-finance: Invoice from Sakura Data Labs (INV-2026-0317) shows 10.21% Japanese withholding. Vendor asking for gross-up. tagging @mike-tax @rachel-legal for next steps. Upload: https://pay.redwood/inv/INV-2026-0317 :thinking_face:

sakura-payments: Thanks Anna — yes we included withholding flag. We're requesting Redwood pays gross-up per PO clause 4.2. We'll attach Certificate of Tax Residence (CoTR) and tax agent letter. Do you need a specific JP tax form or is CoTR sufficient?

mike-tax: Quick heads up — W-8 series won't apply here. For JP nonresidents we need a stamped CoTR (英訳 if possible) and a gross-up schedule showing net -> tax -> gross. @rachel-legal can sign off on gross-up addendum? Also confirm whether payment should be JPY or USD (FX implications).

rachel-legal: We can approve a gross-up only after: (1) signed gross-up addendum, (2) stamped CoTR + translation, (3) written explanation of withholding reason (services vs royalties). Please upload scanned docs.

payments-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0317 attached, amount 1,200,000 JPY. Due 2026-04-15. Status: awaiting vendor docs.

anna-finance: Sakura — can you upload CoTR and signed addendum here: https://files.redwood/upload (secure). Also please provide gross-up calculation line-by-line (tax rate, tax withheld, grossed-up amount) and confirm beneficiary bank (SWIFT).

sakura-payments: Uploaded CoTR and signed addendum to the link. Gross-up calc attached as PDF: tax rate 10.21%, net 1,200,000 JPY, tax 122,520 JPY, grossed-up amount 1,322,520 JPY. Bank: MUFG Tokyo (SWIFT: BOTKJPJT). Happy to provide translated CoTR if needed.

mike-tax: Thanks. Two quick notes: (1) Our tax person expects 10.21% for services but confirm whether contract characterizes this as 'royalties' (different treatments). (2) We need the CoTR stamp scan + english translation and the vendor's Japanese TIN. Also pinging on treaty — if Japan treaty reduces withholding to 0% we won't need gross-up.

anna-finance: Putting invoice on hold in AP until stamped docs in hand. I'll mark as "pending tax docs".

rachel-legal: I'll draft the gross-up addendum template and send for signature after we confirm the scanned CoTR + translation. If vendor can't provide stamped CoTR, we can't gross-up.

anna-finance: Thanks all :thumbsup: Sakura, please send stamped CoTR scan + short translated summary by EOD Fri so we can move forward.

sakura-payments: Understood — will get stamped CoTR scan and translation by EOD Fri. Thanks everyone!
